Description.value: A pack of junk-drone modules that automate chores while the drone follows you. Auto-Loot opens zombie loot bags and containers and grabs dropped items; Auto-Salvage wrenches nearby unclaimed salvageable blocks (cars, sinks, machines) apart; Auto-Harvest reaps and replants grown crops in your land claim; Auto-Repair fixes damaged blocks in your land claim, paying from the drone's own bag; Auto-Plant sows young crops from the drone's bag onto empty farm plots in your claim (pairs with Auto-Harvest for a self-running farm); Auto-Defense turns the drone into a bodyguard that fires its own machine gun at nearby hostiles as it follows you, or stands sentry over the spot you park it on. Two enhancement modules improve the others rather than doing work themselves: Overclock speeds up every installed module, and the Wide-Band Antenna widens every module's reach. Each module is a separate craftable drone attachment unlocked by a looted schematic, and each acts as if you did the work yourself, so your loot stage and perks apply, and each target takes the time it would take you by hand. Modules carry a Quality 1-6 level that scales their reach and speed (and, for the enhancement modules, how much they boost): crafted quality follows your Robotics crafting skill (the Q1 baseline below Robotics 80, rising to Q6 at 100), and traders sell copies rolled by their own stage. Any module can be switched off without pulling it out of the drone: hold E on the drone, pick Talk, then Automation modules, and each function gets a row showing whether it is on, off, or has no module installed. Server-side only: install on the dedicated server, clients install nothing and can keep EAC on. A dedicated server keeps EasyAntiCheat on - it does not gate mod DLLs on anti-cheat. Only a single-player or player-hosted game has to launch with EAC off, because there the server runs inside your own game process.
